overview: The landlord is the property owner, entity, or lessor who grants the right to use and occupy a commercial space to a tenant (lessee) in exchange for rent, typically covering property taxes, insurance, and maintenance depending on the lease type.
preliminary: (Building | Landlord Name| Tenant Name| Lease Guarantor| Suite| Lease Date | Property Name| Street Address| City| State)
General Applicability: All leases (Office, Retail and Industrial)
